title: Data engineer - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:We're looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you'll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.
Develop, schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks. What we are looking for:
A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models...
Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment. What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our " Get Together" where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion) Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of marketing
Progress: every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture: join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship: you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won't give up until we make a huge dent in this industry! Come join us!

title: Ugc content creator (freelance)
description:
About the Company
We are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.
Role Overview
Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for Tik Tok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.
Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.
Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.
Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.
Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.
Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.
Candidate Profile
Strong interest in Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.
Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).
Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.
Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.
Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.
Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.
English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.
Compensation
Per-Video Payment Model: You'll receive compensation for each completed and approved video, with ongoing project opportunities based on performance

title: Corretor de imóveis
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um corretor de imóveis para integrar a equipe da RE/MAX Capital no Distrito Federal. Esse cargo envolve atividades diárias como atendimento a clientes, realização de visitas a propriedades, intermediação de negociações imobiliárias e gestão de carteira de imóveis. O profissional atuará no formato presencial, promovendo vendas e locações de imóveis residenciais e comerciais com excelência e profissionalismo.
Qualificações
Corretagem de Imóveis e Gestão de Propriedades: Experiência como corretor de imóveis e habilidades em gestão de propriedades.
Atendimento ao Cliente: Proficiente em prestar um atendimento de qualidade e personalizado, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
Vendas e Negociação: Capacidade comprovada de realizar vendas e conduzir negociações eficazes, maximizando resultados para todas as partes envolvidas.
Mercado Imobiliário Residencial: Conhecimento em imóveis residenciais e tendência de mercado na região do Distrito Federal.
Desejável possuir registro no CRECI ativo.
Se não possuir registro no CRECI orientamos como obter o registro e iniciar o estagio conosco.

title: Representante técnico de vendas
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.
Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.
Atividades:
●Gestão de Relacionamento: Realizar o planejamento estratégico de visitas via CRM, garantindo a execução rigorosa das rotas e o cumprimento das metas de atendimento.
●Expansão de Mercado: Gerir e prospectar carteiras de clientes de forma ativa, identificando novas oportunidades de negócio na região.
●Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: Ministrar treinamentos técnicos e prestar assistência especializada tanto para canais de distribuição quanto para o cliente final.
●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações.
●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca.
Requisitos e qualificações:
●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia.
●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região.
●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal.
●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

title: Portuguese language specialist
description:
i Merit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.
Role Responsibilities:
Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards. Skills & Competencies:
Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools. Requirements:
Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer:
An innovative and supportive global working environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of
Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage
you to apply!

title: Legal assistant
description:
Position OverviewGemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.
Key Responsibilities
Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
Coordinate with internal teams including e Discovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion Required Qualifications and Skills
Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills
Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
Familiarity with e Discovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus About Gemean
Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like Pyth AI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients' needs.

description:

A Turner & Townsend é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais com mais de colaboradores em mais de 60 países. Trabalhando com nossos clientes nos setores de imobiliário, infraestrutura, energia e recursos naturais, transformamos juntos, entregando resultados que melhoram a vida das pessoas.

Turner & Townsend e CBRE trabalham juntos para fornecer aos clientes a melhor oferta de gestão de programas, projetos e custos em mercados ao redor do mundo.
Descrição da vaga
The Senior Cost Manager will take responsibility for effectively delivering a range of tasks to high quality standard and aid on a wide range of projects of all sizes and dimensions.
The professional will report to a Cost Management Associate Director and will be responsible for commercial aspects of projects in several sectors, supporting with budget management, project cost control, estimation, procurement, and change control during execution.
Candidates should preferably have experience in the Real Estate  sector.
Responsibilities
Included but not limited to: Drive cost estimates according to all design phases, aligned with AACE RPs.
Monitor and control contracts (measurement, claims, penalties, etc.).
Lead value engineering sessions.
Prepare and analyze change orders.
Develop progress measurement criteria with vendors.
Collect cost market data.
Lead procurement processes.
Produce cash flow forecasts for internal and client purposes.
Support on reviewing project budget after design packages issuance by the technical team.
Collaborate with the creation of the recommendation report.
Participate in the weekly project and departmental meetings.
Issue weekly progress reports on project costs including forecasting reimbursable expenses.
Support on stakeholder management.
Qualificações Degree-qualified or equivalent in Engineering or Architecture.
Solid experience working in similar role pre and post contract.
Complete project ownership.
Knowledge in Cost Control, Cost Estimate, Change Orders and Cost Management arerequired.
Knowledge and understanding of the component parts of a project and overall construction costs.
Ability to analyze and interpret commercial and technical project documentation.
Commercial awareness and understanding of the Construction process.
Excellent communication skills, both oral & written.
Negotiation skills and ability to apply those skills internally, externally & with our supply chain.
Positive attitude always and the ability to integrate and play an active part in the Project Team
Good organizational skills and the ability to priorities to meet deadlines.
Keen to pursue personal development needs and keep up to date knowledge.
Advanced experience with the MS Office Package (Project, Word, Excel, and Power Point) and MS Project.
Knowledge and skills with Power BI are a plus.
Fluent in English.
Spanish is a plus.

title: Analista operações logísticas, amzl
description:
Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de EDSP (External Delivery Service Providers), ou seja, as estações de entrega da AMZL operadas por parceiros. Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em escala 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back, podendo haver mudanças de turno.Essa pessoa atuará na gestão de estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria /visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco.Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.Key job responsibilities- Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;- Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;- Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;- Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;- Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;- Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.- MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).- Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.- Disponibilidade para viagens em 25% do tempo.- Inglês básico.

title: Human resources assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions
Do you live in BRAZIL and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing?
Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?
Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?
Can you type both fast and accurately?
Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and income?
Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law?
Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?
Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?
Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations?
Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!
About California Labor Solutions
California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.
What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?
In the U. S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.
We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.
Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:
Compensation:
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL
· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL
· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL
Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.
Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established.
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.
The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL
· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL
· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL
Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.
Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:
· High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a " CLS Certified Investigator's Assistant" (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.
Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office
Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.
Minimum Education/Experience Requirements
Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:
Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement).
A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
A Professional Bachelor's Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.
Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred. Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:
Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.
At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.
A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.
Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year is required.
Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.
A Professional Bachelor's Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred. GROW at CLS! PROMOTIONAL POSITIONS ONLY for CURRENT CLS TEAM MEMBERS:
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SUPERVISOR (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $9,800 BRL to $16,800 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only): The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6 months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
How to Apply? 2 Steps for a Complete Application
Please read the entire job description carefully and apply if you meet all the minimum requirements.
STEP #1: Send an email with the following to :

About California Labor Solutions
California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.
What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?
In the U. S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.
We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.
Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL
· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL
· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL
Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.
Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.
As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established.
HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.
The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:
· Gym membership support: $105 BRL

Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:

About California Labor Solutions
California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.
What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?
In the U. S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.

title: Senior asterisk specialist / latam
description:
DescriptionWe are looking for a highly experienced Asterisk Specialist to join our Level 3 technical support team. This role combines deep hands-on development, tactical guidance, and partner engagement across our technical team. You will be the go-to expert for complex Asterisk core system troubleshooting and custom telephony solutions, working directly with customers and resellers while supporting our internal development teams. This role focuses on Asterisk's underlying engine, custom dialplan development, and advanced Vo IP implementations
English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:
A1 Beginner
A2 Elementary
B1 Intermediate
B2 Upper-Intermediate
C1 Advanced
C2 Proficient Responsibilities
Diagnose and resolve complex Asterisk configuration file and dialplan issues.
Troubleshoot core Asterisk functionality, channel drivers, and application problems.
Elevate telephony engineering skills across our team through mentorship, collaboration, and exemplification.
Support development teams with Asterisk AGI, AMI, and ARI integrations.
Assist with custom Asterisk builds, patches, and telephony application development.
Collaborate closely with technical teams across the enterprise to help transform complex telephony data into actionable insights.
Debug complex dialplan logic and custom Asterisk applications using full logs and real-time traces.
Optimize Asterisk performance, memory usage, and concurrent call handling for high-performance architecture.
Create and maintain detailed documentation for Asterisk configuration patterns and troubleshooting procedures.
Establish team coding standards and best practices for dialplan programming and API integration.
Participate in our on-call schedule to help ensure availability of critical Asterisk core system services.
Provide advanced technical guidance to customers and resellers on custom Asterisk implementations. Requirements
8+ years of experience in engineering, including senior or lead experience in telephony environments.
3+ years of hands-on experience specifically with Asterisk configuration file management and dialplan development.
Deep expertise in Asterisk internals, including dialplan programming, channel configuration, and application development.
Advanced Vo IP knowledge, covering SIP protocol internals, RTP, codec negotiation, and NAT handling.
Strong experience with Linux system administration and command-line expertise.
Proficiency in Asterisk debugging using CLI commands, logging levels, and protocol analysis.
Experience with custom development, specifically AGI scripts, custom applications, and API integrations.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) and working within AWS cloud infrastructure services.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex telephony concepts to non-technical audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred qualifications include Asterisk module development in C, scripting expertise (Python, Perl, PHP), and database integration (Realtime, CDR)

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. No dia a dia você vai:
Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML

Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas

Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos E o que você precisa ter?
Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning Diferenciais:
Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:
No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

title: Consulting partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.
This is not a traditional consultancy role; it's a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA's proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.
What You'll Do
Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
Take ownership of your practice's strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation What You Bring
Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
Confidence in engaging with Cx O-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice This is the ideal next step if you're seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.
By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Staff machine learning engineer | data science
description:
Descrição da vaga
Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.
Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.
Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.
No dia a dia você vai:
Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos E o que você precisa ter?
Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning Diferenciais:
Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:
No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.
Benefícios:
Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
Plano de Saúde;

Previdência Privada;
Benefícios flexíveis que se adaptam às suas necessidades;

Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar;
Empréstimo consignado com taxas reduzidas.

title: Financial advisor
description:
A IBBRA Full Family Office é uma consultoria patrimonial 360o. Nosso propósito é ser para as famílias Brasileiras, um agente de mudança cultural em torno do patrimônio, fomentando emancipação e a realização de objetivos
Buscamos para nossa equipe pessoas dispostas a mudar a cultura patrimonial das famílias brasileiras enquanto se desenvolvem, estruram-se e alcançam novos horizontes.
O executivo de vendas irá atuar no desenvolvimento e gestão da carteira de clientes de alto patrimônio, conduzindo o relacionamento comercial, identificando oportunidades de negócio e assegurando uma experiência consultiva e integrada ao longo de toda a jornada comercial do cliente.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
Gerenciar o relacionamento com o cliente, sendo o principal contato e conselheiro de confiança, prestando consultoria em disponibilidade total e permanente à família atendida.
Atuar de forma consultiva, estratégica e contínua na jornada patrimonial
Atrair, desenvolver e gerir carteira de clientes de alta renda, com foco em crescimento e retenção
Implementar e monitorar estratégias de planejamento patrimonial abrangentes (investimentos, sucessão, proteção e gestão orçamentária), assegurando aderência aos objetivos familiares
Supervisionar carteiras de investimentos e a evolução patrimonial, propondo ajustes conforme perfil de risco e cenário econômico
Conduzir análises financeiras aprofundadas para otimização e alavancagem patrimonial
Coordenar ações multidisciplinares com advogados, contadores e outros especialistas
Coletar e analisar dados financeiros e contextuais, gerando inteligência para tomada de decisão
Promover educação financeira e apoiar a autonomia dos clientes e suas famílias
Atuar com postura ética, fiduciária e independente, em conformidade com as regulamentações Requisitos e Qualificações:
Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas
Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e/ou mercado financeiro
Habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento
Certificação CPA (mínimo) ou em andamento
Diferencial: Certificações CFP, CEA, Ancord, PQO
Diferencial: Inglês intermediário ou avançado O que oferecemos?
Ambiente colaborativo, com oportunidade real de crescimento profissional;
Treinamentos e acompanhamento para desenvolvimento das suas habilidades;
Incentivo intelectual. Informações da vaga:
Plano de carreira e comissionamento compatível com o mercado

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world's biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world? Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We're looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you'll do..
As an Account Manager, you'll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who've already shown interest
Understand what they're building, why it matters, and where they're stuck
Clearly position Oneday's programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates This is not a passive customer success role.
It's a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You'll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results What you'll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Especialista de trade marketing ba
description:
Esse é o propósito que nos inspira e faz com que sejamos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil! Reconhecida como líder nacional nos mercados de massas e biscoitos, estamos entre as maiores companhias do mundo nesses segmentos. Com quase sete décadas de existência, marcamos presença em todo o País com marcas regionais, nacionais e, agora, no Uruguai, nossa primeira aquisição internacional! Com um amplo portfólio de produtos que são sinônimos de sabor e qualidade, temos uma relação de confiança e respeito com consumidores de vários perfis.
Atuamos nos seguintes segmentos: Biscoitos de trigo e arroz; massas de trigo e milho; farinhas e farelos de trigo; misturas para bolos; margarinas e cremes vegetais; bolos; snacks de milho e trigo; torradas; biscoitos cobertos de chocolate; pasta de amendoim; temperos e chocolates; molhos, granolas; cookies; panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos. 
A partir da nossa sede, localizada na cidade de Eusébio, no Ceará, adotamos uma estratégia bem sucedida de construção e aquisição de novas indústrias. Possuímos um moderno parque industrial, com equipamentos de última geração, seguindo os mais rigorosos padrões de qualidade na produção de alimentos e operando com um modelo de integração vertical, que permite a produção de nossas mais importantes matérias-primas. 
Contamos com mais de 17 mil colaboradores distribuídos em 21 unidades industriais no Brasil e 1 no Uruguai. Além disso, temos 29 centros de distribuição, estrategicamente instalados em diferentes Estados, que possibilitam a presença das nossas marcas em todo o território nacional e apoiando à exportação para mais de 40 países. Também negociamos ações no Novo Mercado da B3, bolsa de valores oficial do Brasil.
Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e ao bem comum, considerando a diversidade como o elemento mais importante para geração de resultados e mudanças significativas. Buscamos construir um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados, independentemente de idade, orientação sexual, gênero ou etnia. Todas as nossas oportunidades são acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência, e valorizamos a autenticidade e o potencial de cada talento.
Venha fazer parte desse time de GIGANTES!
Conheça algumas das nossas unidades:
ATENÇÃO CANDIDATOS(AS)! As vagas da M. Dias Branco são divulgadas somente em nosso canal oficial: .

No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas
Será um diferencial se:
Margens por região, canais de vendas, marcas, Análises de Volumes X Margens, ROI / Paybacks /n  Seus desafios serão:  
Liderar a construção dos planos de Trade por cliente, canal e região, conectando áreas parceiras (Canal, Categoria, Marketing, RM e Vendas) e garantindo aderência ao plano nacional.
Construir e gerir o plano trimestral por cliente, incluindo objetivos, metas, calendário promocional, MPDVs, indicadores e budget.
Conduzir e manter JBPs formalizados com clientes SOMA, contemplando metas (DN/DP, share), contrapartidas e rotina estruturada de acompanhamento.
Preparar e conduzir revisões de negócio e apresentações internas e externas (mensais/trimestrais), com análises de performance vs. JBP, recomendações e planos de ação.
Liderar a execução e ativação no ponto de venda, incluindo ações promocionais, visibilidade, priorização de lojas por canal/cliente/cluster e acompanhamento em campo.
Gerir a verba de Trade por cliente e iniciativa, assegurando governança, contratos, contrapartidas, fluxo com Jurídico/Financeiro/RM e avaliação de ROI.
Realizar análises de pós-ações, consolidando resultados, ROI, aprendizados e boas práticas para evolução contínua dos planos.
Capacitar times de vendas e distribuidores, atuando como ponte entre Canal, Categoria, Marketing, RM e Vendas, garantindo coerência da estratégia na execução.

title: Controller / analista financeiro sênior
description:
Descrição de cargo Buscamos um profissional Sênior de Finanças para transformar dados em decisões de negócios (5 hamburguerias, um restaurante italiano, um boteco e um bar de alta coquetelaria) garantindo previsibilidade e rentabilidade das unidades. Então procuramos um profissional que analise os dados, identifique desvios e oriente decisões.
Principais Responsabilidades - FOCO em ANÁLISE e DECISÃO 1. Gestão financeira e inteligência de dados - Consolidar dados enviados pelo BPO e atualizar dashboards financeiros (fluxo de caixa, DRE, budget);- Realizar análise crítica de CMV, CMC, despesas e margem de contribuição por unidade;- Controlar repasses e movimentações financeiras entre empresas do grupo (múltiplos CNPJs); 2. Fluxo de caixa e saúde financeira do Grupo - Entregar posição diária de caixa (saldo, agenda de pagamentos e projeções);- Antecipar riscos e sugerir ações: renegociar, postergar compras, realocar caixa, etc.- Ser guardião de saúde de caixa e da estratégia de capital. 3. DRE e orçamento - Consolidar e entregar DRE mensal por unidade e consolidada; - Estruturar e acompanhar Orçado x Realizado por centro de custo e classificação de gastos; - Elaborar plano de ação junto aos gestores quando houver desvios. 4. Análises estratégicas e suporte à tomada de decisão - Estudos de viabilidade para expansão, novos projetos e investimentos;- Simulações de ROI, margem, payback e ponto de equilíbrio;- Preparar material de apresentação para reunião mensal com sócios. Entregas 1. Entregas Diárias - Posição de caixa consolidada (saldo + projeções + agenda de pagamentos) 2. Entregas Semanais - Atualização de dashboards e relatório de acompanhamento de budget;- Check de desvios e follow-ups com gestores das unidades. 3. Entregas Mensais - Fechamento do mês (DRE gerencial + análise e plano de ação);- Relatório de performance consolidado do grupo e por unidade;- Controle de repasses entre empresas (CNPJs) e validação com sócios. Requisitos  - Sólida experiência com fluxo de caixa, projeções financeiras, DRE gerencial e orçamento;- Excel/ Google Sheets avançado (Power Query / Power BI é diferencial); - Experiência com empresas multiunidade/multicentro de custo ;- Perfil analítico e orientado à entrega - reponsável por transformar números em decisões. Diferenciais - Vivência em food service, varejo de alto volume ou franquias;- Ter atuado como controller/ FP&A/ Analista Financeiro Sênior.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
As a business analyst, you will join a client service team and take ownership of a workstream to solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face.
And these aren’t just any clients—they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. We will expect you to go the extra mile, delivering solutions that solve immediate problems and drive long-term change. And we’ll rely on your judgment and integrity to ensure our recommendations are effective and long-lasting.
You will take on a role that goes beyond advising. You’ll be at the heart of the action—helping to uncover the true challenges behind a client’s strategy and creating actionable plans that drive real change. Working alongside clients and other Mc Kinsey colleagues, you’ll combine research, analyzing data, interviews, and brainstorming to generate fresh insights and breakthrough solutions. A Bahiana é uma instituição de direito privado, sem fins econômicos, de caráter educacional, cultural, científico e assistencial, com foco no ensino, na pesquisa e na extensão dos conhecimentos e serviços próprios da área de saúde, das ciências em geral e da cultura para oferecer à comunidade.
Seu principal objetivo é formar profissionais qualificados com base em valores éticos e humanísticos . Em mais de 70 anos de história , já diplomou mais de 17 mil profissionais da área de saúde. Além disso, é uma Escola nota 5, a nota máxima na avaliação do MEC que menos de 3% das instituições de ensino no Brasil, entre públicas e particulares, possuem . Recentemente, a Bahiana ganhou, pelo sexto ano consecutivo, o prêmio Great Place To Work (GPTW) , premiação global atribuída às empresas que, de acordo com os seus funcionários, são os melhores lugares para trabalhar. Permanecemos no 1º lugar no ranking das melhores empresas para trabalhar na Bahia. Em sua grade, a Bahiana possui cursos de graduação em Medicina, Fisioterapia, Odontologia, Psicologia, Biomedicina, Enfermagem, Educação Física e Tecnólogo em Informática em Saúde, este na modalidade de Educação a Distância. Além da graduação, são mais de 25 cursos de Especialização, Mestrado e Doutorado, sem contar os mais de 20 programas sociais e os cursos de Extensão.
Para além da educação em saúde, a Bahiana Saúde, que abarca o Centro Médico e o Centro Odontológico da Bahiana, presta serviços de saúde à população , contando com o Ambulatório da Comunidade, com as Clínicas de Psicologia e Fisioterapia e com a Clínica Odontológica, além de mais atendimentos em diversas áreas de saúde. Trabalhar na Bahiana é ter o que chamamos de "Bahianidade na veia" . É compartilhar dos nossos valores de Servir, Empreender, Comunicar, Aprender e ensinar . É por isso que queremos agregar talentos que valorizem a nossa tradição , mas que, como a instituição, mirem no futuro, na inovação e no trabalho  para a construção de um mundo no qual a saúde seja valorizada como um direito básico e universal. /n

title: Technical project manager | startup transforming legal tech with ai latam
description:
We connect talented tech professionals in Latin America and Canada with remote career opportunities at innovative startups worldwide. We specialize in finding roles that align with your skills, experience, and career goals. Our personalized approach ensures you're matched with companies that value your contributions and offer opportunities for growth. Whether you're a software engineer, designer, marketer, or other tech professional, we're here to help you take the next step in your career.
About Us Our partner is revolutionizing legal technology with AI-driven tools that enhance efficiency and accessibility for legal professionals. They're undertaking high-impact technology transformation, partnering with a high-volume immigration law firm to optimize workflows and streamline processes.
Role Overview This role exists to own delivery across that complexity. As Senior Technical Project Manager , you are responsible for making sure cross-functional initiatives move from planning to production in a controlled, predictable way. You’ll bring structure where requirements are incomplete, keep teams aligned as priorities shift, and surface risks early enough to change course. Key Responsibilities
Own delivery for initiatives that span multiple engineering teams and systems
Translate technical plans into milestones, sequencing, and clear ownership
Coordinate dependencies to prevent late surprises and delivery bottlenecks
Maintain delivery visibility so tradeoffs happen early, not under deadline pressure
Drive clarification when requirements are incomplete, conflicting, or changing
Identify risks and constraints and guide scope or timeline adjustments
Coordinate release readiness, checks, and rollout timing
Capture post-release issues and feed learnings back into future planning
Technical Proficiency
5+ years owning delivery for complex initiatives in a production Saa S environment
Experience coordinating work across multiple engineering teams and shared systems
Comfortable reading technical plans and challenging assumptions or timelines
Strong judgment around sequencing work, managing dependencies, and making tradeoffs
Proven ability to surface risks early and drive decisions before deadlines force them
Clear, concise written communication for engineers, product, and leadership
Calm, consistent execution when plans change or work slips
Qualifications Linear Expertise : 1+ years of hands-on experience managing engineering projects in Linear in a technical environment. You know the tool cold and can configure it to support complex workflows. Startup Experience : 2+ years in fast-moving startup environments, demonstrating ability to balance process with velocity and build systems from scratch. Technical Credibility : Background that gives you credibility with senior engineers, whether through previous engineering roles, CS degree, technical project management, or deep immersion in technical environments. Process Transformation : Proven track record of inheriting messy project management situations and transforming them into well-functioning systems. You've built or significantly improved PM processes, not just maintained existing ones. Execution Focus : Strong delivery track record with measurable improvements in engineering productivity, predictability, or process efficiency. Communication Skills : Excellent written and verbal communication, able to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders clearly and concisely. Assertiveness and Influence : Ability to enforce standards and push back on poor practices while maintaining positive relationships. You can be firm about process without being a bureaucrat. Analytical Mindset : Data-driven approach to problem-solving, comfortable with metrics, analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions. Nice to have Experience delivering platform, infrastructure, or internal tooling initiatives
Background in regulated, high-availability, or reliability-sensitive systems
Hands-on involvement in release coordination for widely used software
Experience supporting AI-assisted workflows in production
Perks and Benefits Remote-First Work Environment : Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere, with a remote-first setup that supports work-life balance and productivity. Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive salary to recognize and reward your skills and contributions. Unlimited Paid Time Off : Take the time you need with an unlimited PTO policy, empowering you to recharge and maintain balance. Professional Development : Access resources for growth, including conference passes, online courses, and training programs to support your career advancement. Home Office Stipend : We provide a budget for setting up your home office with high-quality equipment and tools. Latest Tech Gear : Receive a top-of-the-line laptop and any necessary peripherals to ensure you have the best tools to do your best work. Team Retreats and Virtual Events : Participate in team-building retreats and regular virtual gatherings to connect with colleagues and strengthen our culture. Parental Leave : We offer paid parental leave to support you and your family during this important time.

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world's biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world? Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We're looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you'll do..
As an Account Manager, you'll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who've already shown interest
Understand what they're building, why it matters, and where they're stuck
Clearly position Oneday's programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates This is not a passive customer success role.
It's a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You'll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results What you'll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Full stack developer
description:

Token Flow is an onchain token clarity platform. A B2 B product, giving protocols complete visibility of their token ecosystem, including: all holder addresses, all transactions and their types, market maker tracking and performance, De Fi positions, and much more.
We're a small, lean team with lots of experience in crypto and tokenomics. We've received funding, and we're looking for our first non-founder hire.

Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs

Own Dev Ops workflows end-to-end — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Pulumi), container orchestration, and environment management

Collaborate across product, data, and infrastructure to ship features end-to-end
Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code Requirements
Previous experience in fullstack, backend-focused software engineering, security engineering, or crypto/web3 development
Strong experience building backend services and APIs
Solid understanding of relational databases, query optimization, and schema design for performance at scale
Experience with Dev Ops practices including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with cloud security fundamentals — secrets management, IAM, network policies, and secure API design
Experience securing API routes and endpoints — proper auth middleware, route guards, role-based access control, and scoped permissions
Understanding of how to handle sensitive data — PII, tokens, credentials — including encryption at rest, masking in logs, and secure storage practices
Experience running and debugging production systems
Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks
Hands-on experience running and maintaining containerized workloads in cloud environments Nice to Have
Experience hardening production systems, database access controls, audit logging, and vulnerability scanning in CI pipelines
Familiarity with the crypto industry, including core blockchain concepts and onchain data
Experience with data-focused platforms (e.g. Dune Analytics, The Graph) and production-grade RPC node integration and monitoring Salary: $36,000 - $42,000 USD
Fully remote, with preference if based in Brazil.

We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.
Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.

You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.
This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.

Backend & Platform

Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar Requirements

title: Professor de música
description:
Na School of Rock Perdizes, transformamos paixão em propósito e música em ferramenta de desenvolvimento pessoal. Parte da maior rede de escolas de música do mundo, com mais de 20 anos de história e presença em mais de 10 países, nossa unidade carrega o compromisso de ir além do ensino musical: desenvolvemos seres humanos através da música.
Nossa metodologia é única e revolucionária. Unimos aulas individuais focadas na técnica e na teoria musical a ensaios semanais em grupo, onde nossos alunos experimentam a prática real de palco, a convivência em banda e o espírito de trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos que é no equilíbrio entre conhecimento técnico e vivência prática que a verdadeira evolução acontece, tanto como músico quanto como pessoa.
Aqui, a música é o meio, mas o desenvolvimento pessoal é o verdadeiro fim. Trabalhamos diariamente para criar um ambiente de acolhimento, respeito e mentalidade de crescimento, ajudando nossos alunos a se tornarem confidentes, resilientes e protagonistas de suas próprias jornadas.
Ensinamos guitarra, baixo, bateria, teclado, violão e canto para todos os níveis de experiência, do iniciante ao avançado. Mais do que aprender a tocar um instrumento, nossos alunos aprendem a brilhar em cima dos palcos mais incríveis do mundo e a levar o poder transformador da música para todas as áreas da vida.
Somos movidos por propósito, paixão e resultado. Se você acredita que a música pode mudar vidas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que trabalha todos os dias para construir uma geração mais forte, mais criativa e mais inspirada, seu lugar é aqui.

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion) Why you should join us

Culture: join the best team you could ever imagine

description:

Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials

Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills
Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred

We utilize advanced platforms like Pyth AI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients' needs.

title: Senior data scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis, essa vaga é para você.
Sobre a Tipspace
A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.
Tecnologias do Projeto
Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:
Bancos de Dados relacionais
Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
SQL para consultas estruturadas
Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código Responsabilidades
Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:
Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção. Requisitos
Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:
Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso. Benefícios e Condições
Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa. Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!
Boa sorte e até breve

title: Client experience specialist
description:

Deliverables are completed on time and within budget

Proactively identify and resolve client issues Delivery & Budget Accountability

High ownership role with direct impact on the business
Clear path to leadership as the company grows
Exposure to U. S.-based clients and finance operations
Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

title: Senior asterisk specialist / latam
description:
DescriptionWe are looking for a highly experienced Asterisk Specialist to join our Level 3 technical support team. This role combines deep hands-on development, tactical guidance, and partner engagement across our technical team. You will be the go-to expert for complex Asterisk core system troubleshooting and custom telephony solutions, working directly with customers and resellers while supporting our internal development teams. This role focuses on Asterisk's underlying engine, custom dialplan development, and advanced Vo IP implementations
English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:
A1 Beginner
A2 Elementary
B1 Intermediate
B2 Upper-Intermediate
C1 Advanced
C2 Proficient Responsibilities
Diagnose and resolve complex Asterisk configuration file and dialplan issues.
Troubleshoot core Asterisk functionality, channel drivers, and application problems.
Elevate telephony engineering skills across our team through mentorship, collaboration, and exemplification.
Support development teams with Asterisk AGI, AMI, and ARI integrations.
Assist with custom Asterisk builds, patches, and telephony application development.
Collaborate closely with technical teams across the enterprise to help transform complex telephony data into actionable insights.
Debug complex dialplan logic and custom Asterisk applications using full logs and real-time traces.
Optimize Asterisk performance, memory usage, and concurrent call handling for high-performance architecture.
Create and maintain detailed documentation for Asterisk configuration patterns and troubleshooting procedures.
Establish team coding standards and best practices for dialplan programming and API integration.
Participate in our on-call schedule to help ensure availability of critical Asterisk core system services.
Provide advanced technical guidance to customers and resellers on custom Asterisk implementations. Requirements
8+ years of experience in engineering, including senior or lead experience in telephony environments.
3+ years of hands-on experience specifically with Asterisk configuration file management and dialplan development.
Deep expertise in Asterisk internals, including dialplan programming, channel configuration, and application development.
Advanced Vo IP knowledge, covering SIP protocol internals, RTP, codec negotiation, and NAT handling.
Strong experience with Linux system administration and command-line expertise.
Proficiency in Asterisk debugging using CLI commands, logging levels, and protocol analysis.
Experience with custom development, specifically AGI scripts, custom applications, and API integrations.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) and working within AWS cloud infrastructure services.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex telephony concepts to non-technical audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred qualifications include Asterisk module development in C, scripting expertise (Python, Perl, PHP), and database integration (Realtime, CDR)

title: Full stack developer
description:

Token Flow is an onchain token clarity platform. A B2 B product, giving protocols complete visibility of their token ecosystem, including: all holder addresses, all transactions and their types, market maker tracking and performance, De Fi positions, and much more.
We're a small, lean team with lots of experience in crypto and tokenomics. We've received funding, and we're looking for our first non-founder hire.
