Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs
Architect, deploy, and operate cloud-native systems on GCP, AWS, or Azure, optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability
Own Dev Ops workflows end-to-end — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Pulumi), container orchestration, and environment management
Build, operate, and optimize data ingestion and processing pipelines for high-volume, event-driven workloads
Integrate and manage RPC-based data sources, designing resilient systems for rate-limited, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data access
Design, query, and optimize relational databases, with a strong focus on data modeling, indexing, query performance, and schema evolution
Monitor and maintain system health — defining SLOs, setting up alerting, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks across services and databases
Apply security best practices across services — authentication, authorization, secrets management, input validation, and safe handling of sensitive data
Secure APIs and services against common vulnerabilities — injection, broken auth, and unauthorized access
Enforce HTTPS and encryption for data in transit and at rest, and apply least-privilege access across services and infrastructure
Run security checks in CI/CD pipelines, maintain audit logs for sensitive operations, and set up rate limiting to protect against abuse
Maintain a workflow, continuously identify risks, review access controls, patch vulnerabilities, and improve defenses as systems evolve
Integrate and secure crypto wallet flows in production — signing, transaction validation, and key management
Collaborate across product, data, and infrastructure to ship features end-to-end
Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code Requirements
Previous experience in fullstack, backend-focused software engineering, security engineering, or crypto/web3 development
Strong experience building backend services and APIs
Solid understanding of relational databases, query optimization, and schema design for performance at scale
Experience with Dev Ops practices including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with cloud security fundamentals — secrets management, IAM, network policies, and secure API design
Experience securing API routes and endpoints — proper auth middleware, route guards, role-based access control, and scoped permissions
Understanding of how to handle sensitive data — PII, tokens, credentials — including encryption at rest, masking in logs, and secure storage practices
Experience running and debugging production systems
Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks
Hands-on experience running and maintaining containerized workloads in cloud environments Nice to Have
Experience hardening production systems, database access controls, audit logging, and vulnerability scanning in CI pipelines
Familiarity with the crypto industry, including core blockchain concepts and onchain data
Experience with data-focused platforms (e.g. Dune Analytics, The Graph) and production-grade RPC node integration and monitoring Salary: $36,000 - $42,000 USD
Fully remote, with preference if based in Brazil.

title: Data analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our client is a rapidly growing Microsoft 365 and Workplace Management consultancy with offices in the UK, Asia and LATAM. They are 100% committed to fostering the growth and development of all our team members. They offer a range of professional development opportunities to support both permanent staff and contractors in advancing their skills and careers. Through training programs, mentorship, and access to industry resources, they ensure that everyone has the tools and support needed to succeed and grow within the organisation.
They are looking for someone who is versatile, with great analysis and documentation skills to work with our project teams to develop data solutions and carry out analysis for our customers. Excellent English-speaking skills and a flexible attitude are a must!
Candidates MUST be located and living in Brazil. Applications from other countries will be immediately rejected.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Analyse, clean and organize raw data from multiple sources
Model and display data with storytelling back to the business and to the programme team
Explain and present technical information to non-experts and support and coach users on technologies
Produce and maintain dashboard reports on project and data migration activity
Troubleshoot Excel related issues such as macros and linked files
Carry out ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for related data migration projects
Create and maintain adhoc and operational reports
Troubleshoot data migration issues as and when required EXPERIENCE
Minimum 2 years working as a Data Analyst
2 years experience creating and deploying custom Power BI dashboards
Experience working on IT infrastructure projects (desirable)
Experience working with Microsoft 365 data (desirable)
Experience working in data migration projects and ETL processes
Experience developing and maintaining Management Information (MI) reports QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Business/B2+ Level English
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
High level of numeracy and attention to detail
Advanced Excel skills (advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA)
Strong Power BI (Power Query, M, DAX)
Microsoft Fabric
Strong analytical and documentation skills
Python Scripting skills (Pandas, Num Py, Seaborn, Matplotlib)
Power Shell scripting (desirable)
SQL skills (desirable)
Developer skills (desirable)
Microsoft Dataverse (desirable)
Microsoft Intelligent Data Platform (desirable)
Good Power Point and presentation skills

Motivated self-starter
Personable and professional manner Our client actively encourages applications from individuals with disabilities and try to provide access, adjustments, equipment, or other practical support where required. title: (sdr) representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Essa vaga é para SDR Júnior (PJ-REMOTO), sem experiência como SDR mas com experiência com vendas.
Estamos em busca de um SDR para ajudar a escalar nossa operação comercial em uma empresa de tecnologia focada em monitoramento e rastreamento veicular.

Além disso, você deve ser capaz de trabalhar em equipe, ter boa capacidade de organização e ser capaz de aprender rapidamente sobre nossos produtos e serviços.

Contatar potenciais clientes por telefone, whats App, e-mail e linkedin para apresentar os produtos e serviços dos nossos clientes;
Qualificar potenciais clientes e agendar reuniões com a equipe de vendas dos nossos clientes
Manter registros precisos e atualizados das interações com os clientes em nosso sistema CRM;
Participar de reuniões e rotinas diárias da empresa. Requisitos:
Habilidade para aprender rapidamente sobre nossos produtos e serviços;
Boa capacidade de organização e gerenciamento de tempo;

Salário inicial de R$ 1.800 fixo + Comissão por performance
Plano de carreira com metas de crescimento.

title: Web & mobile app ui/ux designer
description:
About Chop Dawg
Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Chop Dawg builds custom mobile apps, web platforms, and AI products for partners worldwide. We've launched over 500 apps with a 92% partner retention rate, working with everyone from first-time founders to Fortune 500 companies, including NASA, The White House, Jefferson Health, Six Flags, Wawa, Hilton, the NFL, and the U. S. Navy. Our teams span across the United States, Brazil, and Pakistan.
We don't call our clients \"clients.\" We call them partners, because that's the relationship we build. We're not a vendor you hire and check in with at the end. We're in it with you from day one, and this role is at the heart of how our partners experience the products we create together.
The Role
You GOTTA love designing apps. Not just making screens look beautiful, but thinking deeply about how users interact with digital products, how they move through an experience, and how great design decisions lead to great outcomes.
As a Web & Mobile App UI/UX Designer at Chop Dawg, you'll be joining our growing Brazilian design team of 9 designers, working alongside 2 American designers, as part of an 11-person creative powerhouse. You'll work directly with our partners across the United States and beyond, translating their ideas into thoughtful, polished, and development-ready designs.
This is a full-time, 40-hour per week commitment. Our designers typically manage 2 to 3 active partner projects at any given time, so you need to be someone who thrives juggling multiple workstreams, staying organized, and delivering quality work across all of them without missing a beat.
Every project is different. Our partners span industries and stages, from first-time founders with a napkin sketch to established companies looking to build their next big product. What stays consistent is the standard: every product we design should be something our partners are proud to launch and their users love to use.
What You'll Do
Design mobile apps, web applications, marketing websites, and branding assets for partners across a wide range of industries
Manage your workload across 2 to 3 concurrent projects, keeping each one moving forward on schedule and at a high standard
Create user personas, site maps, wireframes, low-fidelity and high-fidelity designs, product flows, and documentation
Build and maintain component libraries that keep design systems consistent across projects
Develop non-functional prototypes to validate design direction before development begins
Design branding elements including app icons, logo designs, and Apple App Store and Google Play Store assets
Collaborate directly with partners via Zoom to present work, gather feedback, and refine direction
Work closely with project managers, developers, and fellow designers through Slack, Jira, and Confluence to keep projects moving
Participate in design reviews and iterate based on partner and team feedback
Leverage AI tools like Claude and Google Stitch to enhance your workflow and output quality What We're Looking For
Required
Fluent in English, both written and spoken. This is non-negotiable. You will be communicating directly with American partners daily, and clear, professional English is essential.
Reliable, high-speed internet connection
Available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST
Strong portfolio demonstrating experience designing mobile apps, web applications, and branding
Proficiency with Figma as your primary design tool
Experience with user personas, site mapping, wireframing, high-fidelity design, product flows, non-functional prototyping, and component libraries
Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced agency environment
Experience working directly with partners and teams based in the United States
Experience working in an agency setting, ideally serving American or European clientele
Proficiency with Slack and Zoom for daily communication and partner meetings
Available to start immediately or within the next few weeks Nice to Have
Experience designing for wearable devices and tablets
Familiarity with Jira and Confluence
Experience leveraging AI-powered design and productivity tools such as Claude and Google Stitch
Previous project management experience
Background in branding including app icons, logo design, and app store asset creation Compensation
Starting at $1,000 USD/month, scaling up to $4,500 USD/month as you grow into the role and take on expanded responsibilities.
Availability
Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST. This is a full-time, 40-hour per week position. Must be based in Brazil.
Reports To: Design leadership and CEO/CTO
Why Chop Dawg
We don't chase volume. We invest in relationships. That's how we've maintained a 92% partner retention rate and built a portfolio that spans startups, government agencies, and some of the most recognized brands in the world. Our Brazilian design team is growing because the talent is exceptional, and we want you to be part of that growth story. You won't be designing in a silo. You'll be collaborating with a tight-knit, international team that genuinely cares about the work and the people we do it for.
If you take pride in your craft, love working on products that matter to real people, and want to be part of a team that treats design as the foundation of everything we build, we'd love to see your work.
How to Apply
Apply directly through this posting. Include a link to your portfolio. Tell us about your design experience, the types of products you've worked on, and what drew you to this role.
Chop Dawg is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Full stack developer
description:
Company Description
Token Flow is an onchain token clarity platform. A B2 B product, giving protocols complete visibility of their token ecosystem, including: all holder addresses, all transactions and their types, market maker tracking and performance, De Fi positions, and much more.
We're a small, lean team with lots of experience in crypto and tokenomics. We've received funding, and we're looking for our first non-founder hire.
What You'll Do
Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs
Architect, deploy, and operate cloud-native systems on GCP, AWS, or Azure, optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability
Own Dev Ops workflows end-to-end — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Pulumi), container orchestration, and environment management
Build, operate, and optimize data ingestion and processing pipelines for high-volume, event-driven workloads
Integrate and manage RPC-based data sources, designing resilient systems for rate-limited, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data access
Design, query, and optimize relational databases, with a strong focus on data modeling, indexing, query performance, and schema evolution
Monitor and maintain system health — defining SLOs, setting up alerting, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks across services and databases
Apply security best practices across services — authentication, authorization, secrets management, input validation, and safe handling of sensitive data
Secure APIs and services against common vulnerabilities — injection, broken auth, and unauthorized access
Enforce HTTPS and encryption for data in transit and at rest, and apply least-privilege access across services and infrastructure
Run security checks in CI/CD pipelines, maintain audit logs for sensitive operations, and set up rate limiting to protect against abuse
Maintain a workflow, continuously identify risks, review access controls, patch vulnerabilities, and improve defenses as systems evolve
Integrate and secure crypto wallet flows in production — signing, transaction validation, and key management
Collaborate across product, data, and infrastructure to ship features end-to-end
Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code Requirements
Previous experience in fullstack, backend-focused software engineering, security engineering, or crypto/web3 development
Strong experience building backend services and APIs
Solid understanding of relational databases, query optimization, and schema design for performance at scale
Experience with Dev Ops practices including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with cloud security fundamentals — secrets management, IAM, network policies, and secure API design
Experience securing API routes and endpoints — proper auth middleware, route guards, role-based access control, and scoped permissions
Understanding of how to handle sensitive data — PII, tokens, credentials — including encryption at rest, masking in logs, and secure storage practices
Experience running and debugging production systems
Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks
Hands-on experience running and maintaining containerized workloads in cloud environments Nice to Have
Experience hardening production systems, database access controls, audit logging, and vulnerability scanning in CI pipelines
Familiarity with the crypto industry, including core blockchain concepts and onchain data
Experience with data-focused platforms (e.g. Dune Analytics, The Graph) and production-grade RPC node integration and monitoring Salary: $36,000 - $42,000 USD
Fully remote, with preference if based in Brazil.

title: Web & mobile app ui/ux designer
description:
About Chop Dawg
Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Chop Dawg builds custom mobile apps, web platforms, and AI products for partners worldwide. We've launched over 500 apps with a 92% partner retention rate, working with everyone from first-time founders to Fortune 500 companies, including NASA, The White House, Jefferson Health, Six Flags, Wawa, Hilton, the NFL, and the U. S. Navy. Our teams span across the United States, Brazil, and Pakistan.
We don't call our clients \"clients.\" We call them partners, because that's the relationship we build. We're not a vendor you hire and check in with at the end. We're in it with you from day one, and this role is at the heart of how our partners experience the products we create together.
The Role
You GOTTA love designing apps. Not just making screens look beautiful, but thinking deeply about how users interact with digital products, how they move through an experience, and how great design decisions lead to great outcomes.
As a Web & Mobile App UI/UX Designer at Chop Dawg, you'll be joining our growing Brazilian design team of 9 designers, working alongside 2 American designers, as part of an 11-person creative powerhouse. You'll work directly with our partners across the United States and beyond, translating their ideas into thoughtful, polished, and development-ready designs.
This is a full-time, 40-hour per week commitment. Our designers typically manage 2 to 3 active partner projects at any given time, so you need to be someone who thrives juggling multiple workstreams, staying organized, and delivering quality work across all of them without missing a beat.
Every project is different. Our partners span industries and stages, from first-time founders with a napkin sketch to established companies looking to build their next big product. What stays consistent is the standard: every product we design should be something our partners are proud to launch and their users love to use.
What You'll Do
Design mobile apps, web applications, marketing websites, and branding assets for partners across a wide range of industries
Manage your workload across 2 to 3 concurrent projects, keeping each one moving forward on schedule and at a high standard
Create user personas, site maps, wireframes, low-fidelity and high-fidelity designs, product flows, and documentation
Build and maintain component libraries that keep design systems consistent across projects
Develop non-functional prototypes to validate design direction before development begins
Design branding elements including app icons, logo designs, and Apple App Store and Google Play Store assets
Collaborate directly with partners via Zoom to present work, gather feedback, and refine direction
Work closely with project managers, developers, and fellow designers through Slack, Jira, and Confluence to keep projects moving
Participate in design reviews and iterate based on partner and team feedback
Leverage AI tools like Claude and Google Stitch to enhance your workflow and output quality What We're Looking For
Required
Fluent in English, both written and spoken. This is non-negotiable. You will be communicating directly with American partners daily, and clear, professional English is essential.
Reliable, high-speed internet connection
Available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST
Strong portfolio demonstrating experience designing mobile apps, web applications, and branding
Proficiency with Figma as your primary design tool
Experience with user personas, site mapping, wireframing, high-fidelity design, product flows, non-functional prototyping, and component libraries
Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced agency environment
Experience working directly with partners and teams based in the United States
Experience working in an agency setting, ideally serving American or European clientele
Proficiency with Slack and Zoom for daily communication and partner meetings
Available to start immediately or within the next few weeks Nice to Have
Experience designing for wearable devices and tablets
Familiarity with Jira and Confluence
Experience leveraging AI-powered design and productivity tools such as Claude and Google Stitch
Previous project management experience
Background in branding including app icons, logo design, and app store asset creation Compensation
Starting at $1,000 USD/month, scaling up to $4,500 USD/month as you grow into the role and take on expanded responsibilities.
Availability
Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST. This is a full-time, 40-hour per week position. Must be based in Brazil.
Reports To: Design leadership and CEO/CTO
Why Chop Dawg
We don't chase volume. We invest in relationships. That's how we've maintained a 92% partner retention rate and built a portfolio that spans startups, government agencies, and some of the most recognized brands in the world. Our Brazilian design team is growing because the talent is exceptional, and we want you to be part of that growth story. You won't be designing in a silo. You'll be collaborating with a tight-knit, international team that genuinely cares about the work and the people we do it for.
If you take pride in your craft, love working on products that matter to real people, and want to be part of a team that treats design as the foundation of everything we build, we'd love to see your work.
How to Apply
Apply directly through this posting. Include a link to your portfolio. Tell us about your design experience, the types of products you've worked on, and what drew you to this role.
Chop Dawg is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Devops engineer
description:
Own your future
Our culture isn't something people join, it's something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you're on the fence about whether you're a fit, we say go for it. Let's build something great together.
Must haves
6+ years of experience automating the build, test, and deployment of applications.
4+ years of experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies, specifically Docker and Kubernetes (EKS).
Proven experience with CI/CD** and Ia C tools such as Git Hub Actions and Terraform.
Experience with secrets management using Hashi Corp Vault.
Experience with Kubernetes management tools like Argo CD.
Production operations experience in support of applications and cloud infrastructure.
Experience with the Apache stack (Kafka, Flink, Iceberg) is a plus.
B. S. or M. S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Competencies
Hands-on implementation and development with continuous integration, continuous deployment, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and advanced monitoring tools running on Amazon Web Services, and monitoring the performance and ensure stability.
The services you build will enable seamless deployment and management of cloud-based systems.
You will also design how features should be implemented and help determine the best architecture to use in each situation.
Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with an SRE mindset. Key responsibilities
Write Terraform modules to build and manage Infrastructure as Code.
Architect and implement tooling for all aspects of CI/CD, including secrets management with Hashi Corp Vault, particularly for EKS environments.
Engage with Engineering teams to support application deployments, CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions, and migrations towards Ia C.
Implement enhanced logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions, utilizing tools like Grafana.
Drive architecture discussions and design decisions with a focus on simplicity, maintainability, and reliability.
Manage Kubernetes deployments and configurations using Argo CD.
Advocate for transparency and knowledge sharing across the organization through regular blogs, reveals, and pull requests.
Create clear, thorough documentation that sets up other teams for self-guided success.

title: Director of studies
description:
TTA (The TEFL Academy), is the world's largest TEFL (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) teacher training company. Over 15,000 English speakers complete our TEFL qualifications each year and start exciting careers teaching English abroad or online. Our alumni are working in over 100 countries, having life changing experiences, travelling the world and improving the lives of others.
We are looking for a remote Part-Time (20hrs per week) Director of Studies to join our team. You will be responsible for academic delivery and ensure excellence in teaching, assessment, and teacher development.
You will manage the teaching team, oversee lesson quality and assessment standards, and ensure that all academic processes align with industry best practices. You'll play a critical role in teacher recruitment, training, curriculum development, and the ongoing professional development of our staff.
Key Responsibilities Academic Leadership
Provide strategic academic direction
Lead the development and continuous improvement of curricula and teaching resources
Maintain and raise academic quality standards across the programme Team Management & Development
Recruit, train, and manage a team of TEFL trainers
Mentor newly qualified trainers, providing structured onboarding and ongoing support
Deliver in-house training and CPD sessions for teaching and assessment staff
Observe and assess teacher performance, offering developmental feedback Assessment & Quality Assurance
Design, implement, and maintain clear assessment rubrics aligned with learning objectives
Monitor assessment consistency and integrity across the teaching team
Ensure timely, constructive feedback is provided to learners Operational Oversight
Allocate teaching and assessment assignments efficiently
Manage timetabling logistics in line with teacher availability and learner demand
Coordinate with internal teams (e.g. tech, admin, student support) to ensure smooth academic operations
Use IT systems (including ticket lines and online teaching platforms) to manage workflows and communication Problem-Solving & Communication
Take initiative in identifying and resolving academic or operational challenges
Communicate effectively with multiple departments to ensure alignment across functions
Adapt quickly to changing needs, especially during peak periods and across multiple time zones Requirements Essential:
TEFL qualification
DELTA or Dip TESOL qualified
Extensive experience teaching General English to adults online & in-person
Proven track record in teacher training, mentoring, and academic leadership
Experience observing and assessing teaching practices
Strong background in academic scheduling and operations
Strong digital literacy and comfort using educational platforms and IT systems
Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
Ability to problem-solve and adapt in a fast-paced, remote working environment Desirable:
Previous experience as a Director of Studies or in a similar academic leadership role
Experience managing remote teams and asynchronous workflows
Background in recruiting and managing academic staff What We Offer
A senior leadership role in a dynamic, growing international education company
Opportunities for professional development and career progression
Fully remote working arrangement
Flexible working hours, particularly during off-peak periods

title: Software application engineer
description:
***Please send your CV in English
About Foretellix:
Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix's Foretify TM toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V& V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.
Role Description:
Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.

Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.

At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
Have excellent human relationship skills
Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional. Advantages:
Experience in ADAS/AV V& V, testing, and simulation.
Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.

Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

title: Analista de relações com investidores e esg iii
description:
Descrição da vaga
A Helbor Empreendimentos S. A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado da B3, a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.
A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.
Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia. Requisitos e qualificações
Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e Power Point em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal. Informações adicionais
O que nós oferecemos:
Vale Alimentação
Vale Refeição
Assistência Médica
Assistência odontológica
Participação nos Resultados

title: Subject matter expert – chartered & certified accountants (remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing
Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)
Eligible Locations:
Language Requirement: Fluent English
Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory
Hourly Rate: $60.00
Minimum Hours: No minimum
Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability
About Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.
Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.
The Opportunity
We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2 B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.
Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.
What you'll be doing
When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:
Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2 B research is accurate and enterprise-ready. What you'll bring
Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.
Links to more information on Prolific
Website
Youtube
Privacy Statement
By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Business developer & partnerships
description:
Venha fazer parte da Velana
Estamos em busca de um(a) Business Developer & Partnerships com perfil estratégico, visão de mercado e forte capacidade de relacionamento.
Essa posição é voltada à expansão da Velana por meio de novos negócios e parcerias estratégicas, atuando na identificação de oportunidades, construção de alianças comerciais e abertura de novas frentes de crescimento.

A Velana é um gateway de pagamentos digital em crescimento acelerado, conectando e-commerces, plataformas e infoprodutores a soluções de pagamento seguras e eficientes.
Nosso crescimento está diretamente ligado à tecnologia, inteligência comercial e construção de parcerias estratégicas que ampliam nossa presença no mercado.

Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades estratégicas de negócio;
Mapear e estruturar parcerias comerciais (plataformas, agências, integradores e ecossistemas digitais);
Conduzir negociações iniciais e estruturar modelos de parceria;
Prospectar decisores estratégicos (CEOs, Founders, Heads);
Atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo o contexto e necessidades do parceiro;
Analisar mercado, ICPs e potenciais canais de aquisição e crescimento;
Construir e acompanhar pipeline estratégico no CRM;
Trabalhar em conjunto com Vendas, Marketing e Produto para criação de novas frentes de expansão. Requisitos Essenciais
Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento de negócios, parcerias ou vendas consultivas;
Perfil estratégico, com capacidade analítica e visão de longo prazo;
Facilidade para relacionamento e negociação com stakeholders de alto nível;

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:
Grow your training and leadership skills Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.
Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
What you can expect from a career with our team!
Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
Work Setup: Fully remote position You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.
If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Sap technical lead
description:
About SEW
Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and Io T-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.

420+ global clients across the U. S., Europe, Canada, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific
1,550+ employees and growing rapidly
Millions of users engaged monthly
150+ industry awards and global recognition from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, and LA Times Searching for your dream job? Summary
We are seeking a Senior SAP Technical Leader with deep expertise across SAP's core and cloud platforms to design and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for utility enterprises.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP solutions across S/4 HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Service Cloud V2, and SAP IS-U
Architect clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility using ABAP, OData, RAP, and SAP-recommended extension frameworks

Serve as the technical point of contact for complex initiatives, guiding development teams and solution partners

Optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability across the SAP landscape
Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions Required Qualifications
Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
Strong expertise in OData services, REST APIs, and SAP integration patterns
Proven experience implementing clean core–compliant extensibility
Deep knowledge of SAP IS-U in utility enterprise environments
Experience with SAP Service Cloud V2 and SAP CX integrations
Solid understanding of SAP BTP, including extension, integration, and API management services
Strong background in system integration, performance tuning, and scalability
Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions
Utility industry experience
Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory

title: Software engineer sênior - vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !Quais serão suas atividades;Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando Java Script/Type Script e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de Dev Ops, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções. O que nós estamos procurando;

title: Senior full-stack engineer (python + react) — ai startupsenior full-stack engineer - ai productivity platform (remote)
description:
Position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI Platform)
About Us
We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.
Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.
Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.
This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.
Responsibilities
Backend & Platform
Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services in Python
Develop and evolve RESTful and Web Socket APIs supporting AI workflows and enterprise use cases
Build and maintain AI orchestration layers (RAG pipelines, agent systems, retrieval modules)
Integrate multiple data sources: vector databases, structured/tabular data, files, and web search
Own backend architecture decisions with a strong focus on performance, security, and reliability Frontend & User Experience
Build and iterate on production React interfaces using Next.js and Type Script
Translate complex AI capabilities into clean, usable UI patterns — from research dashboards to interactive data views
Implement real-time features such as streaming responses, live status indicators, and dynamic content updates
Ensure frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices Cross-Cutting
Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar Requirements
5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (Fast API or similar)
Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and Type Script
Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Dynamo DB)
Experience with relational and non-relational databases
Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team Nice-to-Haves
Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI agent systems
Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search (e.g. Open Search)
Experience with real-time interfaces (Web Sockets, streaming, SSE)
Background in enterprise Saa S platforms

title: Representante técnico de vendas
description:
A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados.
Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental.
Atividades:
●Gestão de Relacionamento: Realizar o planejamento estratégico de visitas via CRM, garantindo a execução rigorosa das rotas e o cumprimento das metas de atendimento.
●Expansão de Mercado: Gerir e prospectar carteiras de clientes de forma ativa, identificando novas oportunidades de negócio na região.
●Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: Ministrar treinamentos técnicos e prestar assistência especializada tanto para canais de distribuição quanto para o cliente final.
●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações.
●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca.
Requisitos e qualificações:
●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia.
●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região.
●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal.
●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

title: Full-stack developer
description:
Join one of the most exciting early-stage platforms as we scale our engineering team globally.
You'll be building on your full-stack experience, evolving a platform that balances cutting-edge tech with real-world stability. We are looking for a pragmatic \"builder\" who is comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and can take a feature from a raw idea to a polished delivery.
This is a 100% remote contract role (PJ) for a developer based in Brazil, reporting to our US/UK-based leadership. You'll be central to our product delivery, working across the entire stack to ensure our users have a seamless, reliable experience.
Some of your day-to-day will be:
Full-Stack Development: Owning features from end-to-end using Type Script and React.
Backend & Data: Building and maintaining robust services with Postgres and integrating third-party APIs.
Product Evolution: Supporting ongoing feature delivery and improving stability across key user flows.
Code Quality: Contributing to a maintainable codebase as the platform grows, balancing speed with long-term reliability.
Smart Engineering: Utilizing modern tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery without losing sight of fundamental coding principles. Requirements:
Mid-to-Senior Experience: Strong background in Java Script/Type Script and modern frontend frameworks (React).
Database Fluency: Proven experience with relational databases (Postgres or similar).
Startup Mindset: Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment where requirements evolve.
Independent Operator: Able to take ownership of tasks and work autonomously to hit delivery goals.
Communicator: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to collaborate with our international team.
Pragmatic: A focus on \"what works\" and \"what scales,\" avoiding over-engineering where it isn't needed. Benefits:
International Contract (PJ): Competitive remuneration.
100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil.
Direct Impact: Work directly with the founding team; no layers of middle management.
Modern Stack: Access to the latest development tools and a clean, high-velocity environment.
Growth: Opportunity to grow alongside the platform as we scale.

description:

We are screening on a rolling basis—apply now!

title: Staff machine learning engineer | data science
description:
Descrição da vaga
Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.
Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.
Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Data Science Specialist I, você vai somar ao time Data Science que tem como objetivo construir soluções de dados para evoluir experiência do usuário e métricas de negócio de forma escalável.
No dia a dia você vai:
Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos E o que você precisa ter?
Experiência com pipelines de ML/MLOps, CI/CD (Github Actions) e ferramentas como Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, AWS Sagemaker
Conhecimento em containers (Docker), Kubernetes, APIs e Python
Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
Forte entendimento de modelos de Machine Learning Diferenciais:
Experiência com modelagem e manipulação de dados em larga escala
Experiência com processamento e deploy de modelos em tempo real/NRT Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:
No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
Plano de Saúde;

Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar;
Empréstimo consignado com taxas reduzidas.

title: Financial advisor
description:
A IBBRA Full Family Office é uma consultoria patrimonial 360o. Nosso propósito é ser para as famílias Brasileiras, um agente de mudança cultural em torno do patrimônio, fomentando emancipação e a realização de objetivos
Buscamos para nossa equipe pessoas dispostas a mudar a cultura patrimonial das famílias brasileiras enquanto se desenvolvem, estruram-se e alcançam novos horizontes.
O executivo de vendas irá atuar no desenvolvimento e gestão da carteira de clientes de alto patrimônio, conduzindo o relacionamento comercial, identificando oportunidades de negócio e assegurando uma experiência consultiva e integrada ao longo de toda a jornada comercial do cliente.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
Gerenciar o relacionamento com o cliente, sendo o principal contato e conselheiro de confiança, prestando consultoria em disponibilidade total e permanente à família atendida.
Atuar de forma consultiva, estratégica e contínua na jornada patrimonial
Atrair, desenvolver e gerir carteira de clientes de alta renda, com foco em crescimento e retenção
Implementar e monitorar estratégias de planejamento patrimonial abrangentes (investimentos, sucessão, proteção e gestão orçamentária), assegurando aderência aos objetivos familiares
Supervisionar carteiras de investimentos e a evolução patrimonial, propondo ajustes conforme perfil de risco e cenário econômico
Conduzir análises financeiras aprofundadas para otimização e alavancagem patrimonial
Coordenar ações multidisciplinares com advogados, contadores e outros especialistas
Coletar e analisar dados financeiros e contextuais, gerando inteligência para tomada de decisão
Promover educação financeira e apoiar a autonomia dos clientes e suas famílias
Atuar com postura ética, fiduciária e independente, em conformidade com as regulamentações Requisitos e Qualificações:
Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas
Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e/ou mercado financeiro
Habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento

title: Web & mobile app ui/ux designer
description:
About Chop Dawg
Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Chop Dawg builds custom mobile apps, web platforms, and AI products for partners worldwide. We've launched over 500 apps with a 92% partner retention rate, working with everyone from first-time founders to Fortune 500 companies, including NASA, The White House, Jefferson Health, Six Flags, Wawa, Hilton, the NFL, and the U. S. Navy. Our teams span across the United States, Brazil, and Pakistan.
We don't call our clients \"clients.\" We call them partners, because that's the relationship we build. We're not a vendor you hire and check in with at the end. We're in it with you from day one, and this role is at the heart of how our partners experience the products we create together.
The Role
You GOTTA love designing apps. Not just making screens look beautiful, but thinking deeply about how users interact with digital products, how they move through an experience, and how great design decisions lead to great outcomes.
As a Web & Mobile App UI/UX Designer at Chop Dawg, you'll be joining our growing Brazilian design team of 9 designers, working alongside 2 American designers, as part of an 11-person creative powerhouse. You'll work directly with our partners across the United States and beyond, translating their ideas into thoughtful, polished, and development-ready designs.
This is a full-time, 40-hour per week commitment. Our designers typically manage 2 to 3 active partner projects at any given time, so you need to be someone who thrives juggling multiple workstreams, staying organized, and delivering quality work across all of them without missing a beat.
Every project is different. Our partners span industries and stages, from first-time founders with a napkin sketch to established companies looking to build their next big product. What stays consistent is the standard: every product we design should be something our partners are proud to launch and their users love to use.
What You'll Do
Design mobile apps, web applications, marketing websites, and branding assets for partners across a wide range of industries
Manage your workload across 2 to 3 concurrent projects, keeping each one moving forward on schedule and at a high standard
Create user personas, site maps, wireframes, low-fidelity and high-fidelity designs, product flows, and documentation
Build and maintain component libraries that keep design systems consistent across projects
Develop non-functional prototypes to validate design direction before development begins
Design branding elements including app icons, logo designs, and Apple App Store and Google Play Store assets
Collaborate directly with partners via Zoom to present work, gather feedback, and refine direction
Work closely with project managers, developers, and fellow designers through Slack, Jira, and Confluence to keep projects moving
Participate in design reviews and iterate based on partner and team feedback
Leverage AI tools like Claude and Google Stitch to enhance your workflow and output quality What We're Looking For
Required
Fluent in English, both written and spoken. This is non-negotiable. You will be communicating directly with American partners daily, and clear, professional English is essential.
Reliable, high-speed internet connection
Available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST
Strong portfolio demonstrating experience designing mobile apps, web applications, and branding
Proficiency with Figma as your primary design tool
Experience with user personas, site mapping, wireframing, high-fidelity design, product flows, non-functional prototyping, and component libraries
Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced agency environment
Experience working directly with partners and teams based in the United States
Experience working in an agency setting, ideally serving American or European clientele
Proficiency with Slack and Zoom for daily communication and partner meetings
Available to start immediately or within the next few weeks Nice to Have
Experience designing for wearable devices and tablets
Familiarity with Jira and Confluence
Experience leveraging AI-powered design and productivity tools such as Claude and Google Stitch
Previous project management experience
Background in branding including app icons, logo design, and app store asset creation Compensation
Starting at $1,000 USD/month, scaling up to $4,500 USD/month as you grow into the role and take on expanded responsibilities.
Availability
Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST. This is a full-time, 40-hour per week position. Must be based in Brazil.
Reports To: Design leadership and CEO/CTO
Why Chop Dawg
We don't chase volume. We invest in relationships. That's how we've maintained a 92% partner retention rate and built a portfolio that spans startups, government agencies, and some of the most recognized brands in the world. Our Brazilian design team is growing because the talent is exceptional, and we want you to be part of that growth story. You won't be designing in a silo. You'll be collaborating with a tight-knit, international team that genuinely cares about the work and the people we do it for.
If you take pride in your craft, love working on products that matter to real people, and want to be part of a team that treats design as the foundation of everything we build, we'd love to see your work.
How to Apply
Apply directly through this posting. Include a link to your portfolio. Tell us about your design experience, the types of products you've worked on, and what drew you to this role.
Chop Dawg is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Senior asterisk specialist / latam
description:
DescriptionWe are looking for a highly experienced Asterisk Specialist to join our Level 3 technical support team. This role combines deep hands-on development, tactical guidance, and partner engagement across our technical team. You will be the go-to expert for complex Asterisk core system troubleshooting and custom telephony solutions, working directly with customers and resellers while supporting our internal development teams. This role focuses on Asterisk's underlying engine, custom dialplan development, and advanced Vo IP implementations
English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:
A1 Beginner
A2 Elementary
B1 Intermediate
B2 Upper-Intermediate
C1 Advanced
C2 Proficient Responsibilities
Diagnose and resolve complex Asterisk configuration file and dialplan issues.
Troubleshoot core Asterisk functionality, channel drivers, and application problems.
Elevate telephony engineering skills across our team through mentorship, collaboration, and exemplification.
Support development teams with Asterisk AGI, AMI, and ARI integrations.
Assist with custom Asterisk builds, patches, and telephony application development.
Collaborate closely with technical teams across the enterprise to help transform complex telephony data into actionable insights.
Debug complex dialplan logic and custom Asterisk applications using full logs and real-time traces.
Optimize Asterisk performance, memory usage, and concurrent call handling for high-performance architecture.
Create and maintain detailed documentation for Asterisk configuration patterns and troubleshooting procedures.
Establish team coding standards and best practices for dialplan programming and API integration.
Participate in our on-call schedule to help ensure availability of critical Asterisk core system services.
Provide advanced technical guidance to customers and resellers on custom Asterisk implementations. Requirements
8+ years of experience in engineering, including senior or lead experience in telephony environments.
3+ years of hands-on experience specifically with Asterisk configuration file management and dialplan development.
Deep expertise in Asterisk internals, including dialplan programming, channel configuration, and application development.
Advanced Vo IP knowledge, covering SIP protocol internals, RTP, codec negotiation, and NAT handling.
Strong experience with Linux system administration and command-line expertise.
Proficiency in Asterisk debugging using CLI commands, logging levels, and protocol analysis.
Experience with custom development, specifically AGI scripts, custom applications, and API integrations.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) and working within AWS cloud infrastructure services.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex telephony concepts to non-technical audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred qualifications include Asterisk module development in C, scripting expertise (Python, Perl, PHP), and database integration (Realtime, CDR)

title: Professor de música
description:
Na School of Rock Perdizes, transformamos paixão em propósito e música em ferramenta de desenvolvimento pessoal. Parte da maior rede de escolas de música do mundo, com mais de 20 anos de história e presença em mais de 10 países, nossa unidade carrega o compromisso de ir além do ensino musical: desenvolvemos seres humanos através da música.
Nossa metodologia é única e revolucionária. Unimos aulas individuais focadas na técnica e na teoria musical a ensaios semanais em grupo, onde nossos alunos experimentam a prática real de palco, a convivência em banda e o espírito de trabalho em equipe. Acreditamos que é no equilíbrio entre conhecimento técnico e vivência prática que a verdadeira evolução acontece, tanto como músico quanto como pessoa.
Aqui, a música é o meio, mas o desenvolvimento pessoal é o verdadeiro fim. Trabalhamos diariamente para criar um ambiente de acolhimento, respeito e mentalidade de crescimento, ajudando nossos alunos a se tornarem confidentes, resilientes e protagonistas de suas próprias jornadas.
Ensinamos guitarra, baixo, bateria, teclado, violão e canto para todos os níveis de experiência, do iniciante ao avançado. Mais do que aprender a tocar um instrumento, nossos alunos aprendem a brilhar em cima dos palcos mais incríveis do mundo e a levar o poder transformador da música para todas as áreas da vida.
Somos movidos por propósito, paixão e resultado. Se você acredita que a música pode mudar vidas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que trabalha todos os dias para construir uma geração mais forte, mais criativa e mais inspirada, seu lugar é aqui.
Vaga: Professor de música - Piano/teclado ou Canto - School of Rock Perdizes Pompeia
A School of Rock Perdizes está em busca de professores(as) de música apaixonados por ensinar, tocar e viver a música para integrar nosso time pedagógico. Ministrar aulas individuais e coletivas de música, de acordo com a metodologia School of Rock
Trabalhar com alunos de diferentes faixas etárias e níveis (crianças, adolescentes e adultos)
Preparar alunos para ensaios em banda e apresentações ao vivo
Estimular a prática musical, a escuta, a performance e a musicalidade
Participar ativamente da rotina pedagógica da escola, incluindo reuniões, ensaios e eventos
Colaborar com outros professores e direção musical no desenvolvimento dos alunos
Seguir a metodologia da School of Rock e estudá-la constantemente O que esperamos de você:
Domínio em um ou mais instrumentos (Buscamos professores de teclas (piano e teclado) e professores de canto)
Experiência prévia como professor(a) de música ou músico(a) atuante

Boa comunicação, didática e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe

title: Director of studies
description:
TTA (The TEFL Academy), is the world's largest TEFL (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) teacher training company. Over 15,000 English speakers complete our TEFL qualifications each year and start exciting careers teaching English abroad or online. Our alumni are working in over 100 countries, having life changing experiences, travelling the world and improving the lives of others.
We are looking for a remote Part-Time (20hrs per week) Director of Studies to join our team. You will be responsible for academic delivery and ensure excellence in teaching, assessment, and teacher development.
You will manage the teaching team, oversee lesson quality and assessment standards, and ensure that all academic processes align with industry best practices. You'll play a critical role in teacher recruitment, training, curriculum development, and the ongoing professional development of our staff.
Key Responsibilities Academic Leadership
Provide strategic academic direction
Lead the development and continuous improvement of curricula and teaching resources
Maintain and raise academic quality standards across the programme Team Management & Development

Deliver in-house training and CPD sessions for teaching and assessment staff
Observe and assess teacher performance, offering developmental feedback Assessment & Quality Assurance

Monitor assessment consistency and integrity across the teaching team
Ensure timely, constructive feedback is provided to learners Operational Oversight

Take initiative in identifying and resolving academic or operational challenges
Communicate effectively with multiple departments to ensure alignment across functions
Adapt quickly to changing needs, especially during peak periods and across multiple time zones Requirements Essential:
TEFL qualification
DELTA or Dip TESOL qualified
Extensive experience teaching General English to adults online & in-person
Proven track record in teacher training, mentoring, and academic leadership
Experience observing and assessing teaching practices
Strong background in academic scheduling and operations
Strong digital literacy and comfort using educational platforms and IT systems
Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
Ability to problem-solve and adapt in a fast-paced, remote working environment Desirable:
Previous experience as a Director of Studies or in a similar academic leadership role
Experience managing remote teams and asynchronous workflows

Opportunities for professional development and career progression
Fully remote working arrangement
